The first images show 'Chibi Fujie' (ちびフジィ), a cute chrome-silver sturgeon mascot, its expression sheet, and a previous sticker sheet whose art style you must match exactly.

CRITICAL RULE: the sheet has exactly 20 stickers and EVERY caption must be DIFFERENT. Never repeat a caption. Each caption in the list below must appear exactly once, on the correct sticker, and every sticker must have its caption. Count carefully before finishing.

Create a JAPANESE LINE STICKER SHEET: 4 columns by 5 rows of 20 separate die-cut stickers on a pure white background, each with a thick white sticker border.
